definition: A defined rectangular area at an aerodrome prepared for the landing and take-off of aircraft (illustrative paraphrase).
difficulty_note: Russian and Kazakh use descriptive multi-word terms; Russian also uses the established abbreviation ВПП instead of borrowing RWY.

definition: The service that directs aircraft to prevent collisions and keep air traffic flowing in an orderly way (illustrative paraphrase).
difficulty_note: ATC names both the service and the controlling unit; Russian uses its own abbreviation УВД rather than borrowing ATC.

definition: An authorization from air traffic control for an aircraft to proceed under specified conditions (illustrative paraphrase).
context: Pilots shall read back the ATC clearance.
difficulty_note: Polysemous: an ATC clearance (authorization) differs from obstacle clearance (vertical distance above obstacles, Russian «запас высоты над препятствиями»). The equivalent is chosen by meaning and context.

definition: An instruction to stop before a specified point, such as a runway, and wait (illustrative paraphrase).
difficulty_note: Imperative with a locative phrase; Russian restructures the clause around the verb «ожидать».

definition: A procedure in which an aircraft on approach discontinues the landing and climbs to make another approach (illustrative paraphrase).
context: Go around, I say again, go around.
difficulty_note: Russian and Kazakh equivalents are descriptive; consistency across documents should be checked.

definition: An instruction to set a given code on the aircraft transponder (illustrative paraphrase).
difficulty_note: Jargon verb with no one-word equivalent; Russian and Kazakh use descriptive translation.
